Open the deck [in its own tab](../../live/day.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: the `d` key switches the optional runs of slides on and off, `[` and `]` jump between parts, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title. R loads inside the deck when it is opened, and the cells on its hands-on slides show each step of the five tasks with its output.
